agentAccess.title: Agent access
agentAccess.intro: Connect an MCP client through this desktop app. Access is off by default and only covers the lists you select.
agentAccess.unavailable: Agent access could not be verified. No permissions were changed. Reopen this panel to try again.
agentAccess.write: Allow task changes (create, edit and complete)
agentAccess.scopeHelp: Only selected lists are included. New lists are not added automatically. Existing list permissions still apply.
agentAccess.empty: No available lists. Create a list before enabling access.
agentAccess.review: I have reviewed this server, account, list scope and the requested read/write permissions.
agentAccess.rotateHelp: Enabling or renewing access creates a new credential and invalidates the previous one. Where supported, it is stored in a private local file; otherwise a one-time token is shown. Restart your MCP client after every renewal.
agentAccess.tokenHelp: Keep this token private. Copy it into your MCP client, then clear it here. It will not be shown again.
agentAccess.copied: Token copied. Clear your clipboard after configuring your client.
agentAccess.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the token manually.
agentAccess.failed: The change could not be confirmed. Reopen this panel to check the current access before retrying.
agentAccess.requirements: Keep this desktop app running and signed in. Access is bound to this server and account. Sign-out, server switching or restarting the desktop app requires a new grant.
agentAccess.configHelp: Requires Node.js 24. Run npm ci and npm run build in the source application directory, then replace the path below with the absolute path to dist/server/mcp.mjs.
agentAccess.active: Agent access is enabled for this desktop session.
agentAccess.readScope: Read access includes task titles, descriptions and task fields in selected lists, but not comments, attachments or history. Completing a task can also complete subtasks and create its next recurring instance.
agentAccess.descriptorHelp: This configuration references a private credential file, not the token itself. Revoking access or quitting normally removes the file. Re-enabling the same server and account restores this path; another target gets a different path. Restart the MCP client after renewing access. Never upload or share the file.
agentAccess.tokenConfigHelp: Protected credential files are unavailable on this platform. Put the one-time token in the environment variable below, never in a URL or command-line argument. Update the endpoint and token after a new desktop session.
agentAccess.packagedConfigHelp: Add this configuration to an MCP client that supports local stdio. It uses your installed Qingdan executable; no separate Node.js is needed. The Qingdan desktop app must remain running and signed in.
agentAccess.codexHelp: Merge this TOML into ~/.codex/config.toml. Update an existing qingdan entry instead of duplicating it; keep your other settings. Restart Codex afterward.
agentAccess.opencodeHelp: Merge the qingdan entry into the mcp object in your opencode.json or opencode.jsonc. Keep other configuration entries, then restart OpenCode.
agentAccess.configCopied: 연결 정보를 복사했습니다. 클라이언트의 설정 형식에 맞게 입력하고 토큰 자리표시자는 비공개로 교체하세요.
agentAccess.configCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the configuration manually.
agentAccess.genericHelp: command, args, env 필드는 표준 로컬 stdio 연결 정보이며 모든 클라이언트에 공통으로 적용되는 설정 파일이 아닙니다. 사용하는 MCP 클라이언트의 설정 형식에 맞게 입력하세요. Codex와 OpenCode는 선택 가능한 형식 템플릿이며 프로토콜 지원을 제한하지 않습니다.
